# Partners

Part of the **Partners** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List partners

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/partners/partners`

Retrieve a paginated list of partners with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: parent, country, state, title, company, industry, user, creator, addresses, contacts, bankAccounts, tags | `tags,addresses` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[account_type]` | string | No | Filter by account type |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by partner name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[email]` | string | No | Filter by email (partial match) |  |
| `filter[phone]` | string | No | Filter by phone (partial match) |  |
| `filter[parent_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of parent IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[user_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of user IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of company IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[title_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of title IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[industry_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of industry IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[country_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of country IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[state_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of state IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[trashed]` | string | No | Filter by trashed status. Available options: with, without, only |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `name` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/partners/partners?include=tags%2Caddresses&sort=name&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]

  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

## Create partner

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/partners/partners`

Create a new partner

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `account_type` | string | Yes | Account type. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Partner name (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `email` | string | No | Email address (max 255 characters). Must be a valid email address. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `phone` | string | No | Phone number (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `mobile` | string | No | Mobile number (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `avatar` | string | No | Avatar file path (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `job_title` | string | No | Job title (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `website` | string | No | Website URL (max 255 characters). Must be a valid URL. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `tax_id` | string | No | Tax identification number (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `company_registry` | string | No | Company registry number (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `reference` | string | No | Reference code (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `color` | string | No | Color in hex format (max 7 characters). Must not be greater than 7 characters. |
| `street1` | string | No | Street address line 1 (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `street2` | string | No | Street address line 2 (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `city` | string | No | City (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `zip` | string | No | Postal/ZIP code (max 20 characters). Must not be greater than 20 characters. |
| `state_id` | integer | No | State ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `country_id` | integer | No | Country ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `parent_id` | integer | No | Parent partner ID (for addresses and contacts). Must match an existing stored value. |
| `title_id` | integer | No | Title ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `industry_id` | integer | No | Industry ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `user_id` | integer | No | Associated user ID/Responsible Sale user. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
}'
```

## Show partner

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/partners/partners/{id}`

Retrieve a specific partner by its ID

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The partner ID |


**Query parameters**

| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: parent, country, state, title, company, industry, user, creator, addresses, contacts, bankAccounts, tags | `tags,addresses` |
